name: Time-to-default survival analysis benchmark for credit scoring
description: A benchmark study evaluating survival analysis models for predicting time to default in credit-scoring datasets.
reputation: Used in academic research on credit-risk modelling and survival methods; respected for bringing time-to-default framing to credit scoring but less common in commercial pipelines.
notes: Real-world credit data include censoring and class imbalance; results are dataset-dependent and sensitive to feature engineering and censoring handling; privacy/regulatory concerns may limit dataset availability; non-LLM benchmark.
